title: Nevada Thacker Pass Environmental Permit Hub — Phase 65 Nevada lithium project delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Nevada lithium project delivery reporting pack. NDEP's project hub identifies Thacker Pass air, water-pollution-control, and reclamation records and supplies permit identifiers for continued project-level monitoring.
key_findings: The state rail makes several environmental authorizations discoverable for one named project.
The permit identifiers support later checks of modifications, monitoring, inspections, violations, and enforcement.
A hub and issued permit stack do not establish actual water use, emissions, reclamation performance, or production.
why_it_matters: Which records separate land and environmental authorization, financing, construction, commissioning, compliance, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The page turns a general environmental concern into a repeatable state compliance trail.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a project-level Nevada permit discovery rail.
Connects authorization to inspection and operating evidence.
Supports checks against claims of construction and compliant operation.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The hub is an index and should be paired with the actual permits and later compliance records.
Permit issuance does not prove construction or condition satisfaction.
The record does not establish production, product quality, sales, or environmental outcomes.
